message.name: VIZTRA_TARGET
message.description: Position and motion of the selected Viztra docking target. Private MAVLink 2 message.
message.field: QGC boot time when this sample was received.
Monotonic target sample number within the simulation session.
Target altitude above mean sea level.
Target north, east and down velocity.
Bit 0: position valid; bit 1: velocity valid.

message.name: DOCK_GUIDANCE_STATUS
message.description: DockGuidance entry and runtime status from the flight controller. Private MAVLink 2 message.
message.field: Flight controller boot time of this status.
Visual relative range, NaN when unavailable.

Bit 0 mode registered; 1 active; 2 entry ready; 3 visual setpoint valid; 4 QGC target fresh; 5 camera encoder ready; 6 fault latched; 7 preposition enabled; 8 preposition active; 9 vision degraded; 10 encoder required.
First blocking entry condition, or Ready.
